title: awesome
text: awesome. pretty cool  :)  cant wait to see how the coffee comes out  a bit strong with the zell strainer ............i will put less coffee in the next batch and find the right amount eventually  trial and error  .....  i added lots of half and half and some vanilla and cinnamon  .. i put it in my 52 oz bubba mug  and im enjoying my first very delicious cup of ice coffee for the summer !!
